title: docs(sprints): register NECK-DEFER-001 neck & fretboard solver handoff (deferred)
intent: Record, as a deferred queue entry with a developer handoff, the plan to wire a standalone neck & fretboard solver (width, compound fretboard radius, board and neck thickness, back profile at any station; DXF cross-sections) into the Toolbox as a generic neck tool.
